# Hosea Chapter 13 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 332v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HOS_013_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**13:4** And-I am YHWH your-God from-the-land of-Mitsrayim; and-a-God elohim besides-me zulati you-do-not know lo teda, and-a-savior moshia there-is-none ein except-me bilti.

**13:7** And-I-will-be va'ehi to-them like-a-lion ke-shachal; like-a-leopard ke-namer on-the-way al-derekh I-will-lurk ashur.

**13:8** I-will-meet-them efgoshem like-a-bear ke-dov robbed-of-cubs shakkul, and-I-will-tear-open ve-eqra the-covering segor of-their-heart libbam; and-I-will-devour-them va'okhlom there like-a-lion ke-lavi; the-beast chayyat of-the-field ha-sadeh will-tear-them tevaqqe'em.

**13:14** From-the-hand mi-yad of-Sheol I-will-ransom-them efdom; from-death mi-mavet I-will-redeem-them eg'alem. Where ehi are your-plagues devarkha, O-death mavet? Where ehi is your-destruction qotovkha, O-Sheol? Compassion nocham is-hidden yissater from-my-eyes.

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Hosea 13 — "The LORD's Relentless Judgment" — continues the book's distinctive blend of personal biography and national theology. The marriage metaphor that structures the entire book gives Hosea an emotional intensity unmatched in the prophetic corpus.

---
## Disagreement Log

This chapter produced minor register disagreements resolved through SOPHIA's standard consensus process.
